point.title: Reusable Agent Contexts
point.rationale: AgentContext is a validated, hashed conversation value with coherent tool-call history and pinned source references. AgentContextLibrary manages durable creation, forks, comments, and discovery. Source adapters choose committed Git content or immutable snapshots and can produce portable selected-range exports. This is the reusable input boundary shared by editing and evaluations.
